product_overview: CVCraft is a modern web-based resume builder designed to help users create professional, ATS-friendly resumes through an intuitive interface featuring multiple templates, real-time previews, and secure user authentication with data persistence.
core_goals: Provide an intuitive interface for creating professional resumes
Offer multiple professionally designed templates for diverse user preferences
Enable real-time preview and editing of resumes
Support high-quality PDF export functionality preserving template styles
Implement secure user authentication and personalized profile management
Ensure mobile-responsive and accessible design across devices
key_features: User Authentication with email/password signup, verification, login, and session management via Supabase Auth
Resume Builder with multi-tabbed forms for comprehensive sections including personal info, summary, experience, education, and skills
Multiple professionally designed resume templates including Modern Blue, Minimal Classic, Creative Edge, and more
Dashboard for managing multiple resumes with full CRUD operations
User Profile management for updating personal info and avatars
Real-time resume preview with auto-save for seamless editing experience
PDF Export preserving template styling using jsPDF and html2canvas
Responsive Navigation with protected routing based on authentication state
Comprehensive UI Component Library built with Radix UI and shadcn/ui for consistent UX
Input validation and sanitation ensuring security and data integrity with React Hook Form and Zod
user_flow_summary: Users land on the marketing Landing Page and can navigate to sign-up or sign-in on the Authentication page
Upon authentication, users access the Dashboard to manage existing resumes or create new ones
In the Resume Builder, users fill out multi-tab forms capturing all resume data with instant visual preview
Users select from multiple templates for their resume style in the Templates page
Users can update their profile information and avatar via the Profile page
Resumes can be exported to PDF maintaining the selected template’s design for download
Protected routes ensure only authenticated users access resume builder, dashboard, and profile pages
Error handling pages like 404 Not Found manage unmatched routes gracefully
validation_criteria: Successful user registration, login, email verification, and secure session persistence
Accurate validation of all resume form fields with client/server enforcement
Correct rendering and switching between multiple resume templates with real-time preview
Effectiveness of automatic saving and CRUD operations on resumes in user dashboard
Proper export of resumes to PDF with template styling preserved and file integrity validated
Responsive user interface across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices with no layout break
Security enforcement including row-level database access, XSS and CSRF protection
Navigation flows maintain authentication state and protect restricted content
Error states (e.g., 404) display appropriate messages and redirect as needed
